text:
Lina Torres: Noticing p50 stable but p99 jumps in the dashboard for service:embed-endpoint. Endpoint breakdown shows p99 flat. Something's off with provenance.

Evan K.: Likely two things: (1) console uses tdigest rollups across shards, (2) endpoint pane is pulling denormalized per-backend raw samples but with retries filtered differently.

Priya Nair: Are retries included in the percentile calculation for the endpoint pane? We have been inconsistent across UIs.

Carlos M.: Historically we excluded client retries from endpoint raw-sample view but included them in global rollup for aggregate availability. That would shift tail if retries hit slow backends.

Lina Torres: Ah. So a small fraction of retried requests landing on slow variant could blow up p99 in the rollup but not appear in endpoint list if the endpoint query filters retries.

Evan K.: We should add a "provenance" micro-badge next to each percentile metric: shows included-or-excluded flags (retries, ingress vs backend), raw-sample-count, and tdigest-shard-count. Tooltip expands into a short explanation.

Priya Nair: UX ask: also provide a toggle in the chart to switch between "raw-samples" and "merged-sketch" so SREs can flip views quickly during incidents.

Carlos M.: API debate: do we want default toggles to be conservative? I vote default = merged-sketch (cheaper) with an explicit opt-in for raw-samples (heavy). We can surface cost estimate in the tooltip.

Evan K.: Technical note: merged tdigest underweights skewed shards when sketch compression is tight. Two mitigation ideas: 1) increase sketch resolution for percentile windows where sample counts are low, 2) maintain an origin-weighted correction factor when shards report extreme tails.

metrics-bot: telemetry job "percentile-drift-check" scheduled: run daily at 03:00 UTC. Will compare merged-sketch p99 vs raw-sample p99 on synthetic slow-2percent fanout.

Lina Torres: We should also auto-annotate the timeseries when routing policies change or quota fallbacks kick in. Annotation fields: policy id, old->new weights, fallback pool id, and percent traffic affected.

Priya Nair: +1. And add an explanation entry for "Why did p99 change?" that lists top probable causes: routing-weight change, quota token exhaustion, smoothing-window misalignment, retries inclusion, low sample counts, tdigest compression loss. Include links to rollout logs and quota events.

Carlos M.: Small internal API proposal: /internal/telemetry/percentile_provenance?service=embed-endpoint&start=... returns provenance metadata per-bucket. Lightweight JSON: shard_counts, sketch_size, retry_included, fallback_traffic_pct. We can gate it to internal console only.

Evan K.: One more: timezone alignment bug — console and endpoint panes were accidentally using different bucket alignment for daylight saving cutover tests. Let's standardize on UTC-aligned buckets everywhere.

canary-bot: canary deploy "console/provenance-badge" promoted to canary at 1785560025 :rocket: 

Lina Torres: I'll open a tiny RFC summarizing UX + API + telemetry checks and link to the canary. Priya/Evan/Carlos please add comments for design and feasibility.

Priya Nair: I'll mock the tooltip copy and the toggle flow. Evan, can you add the weekly drift alert (warn if merged_sketch_p99 differs from raw_p99 by > 12% for > 3 days)?

Evan K.: Yep, adding the alert. Also will add a test that injects 2% slow fanout across 3 shards to validate correction heuristics.

Lina Torres: Thanks. If we ship the badge and the provenance endpoint behind a feature flag this week, ops can triage a lot faster during paging. :thumbsup:
